To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
there are many problems in the occupational skill training of regular physical education teachers.

the Physical Education Curriculum Program and Curriculum Standard have set fort new requirements on physical education teacher occupational skill cultivation, but the curriculum programs of the education major of the 6 physical education departments of normal institutes of higher education in Huizhou City are not in line with the requirements.

the Physical Education Curriculum Program has set new requirements for physical teachers’ occupational skills in terms, the curriculum program has had a new break-through in cultivation objectives for physical education majors, increased curriculum courses, added curriculum forms and extended the flexibility of the curriculum structure, but it fails to show enough attention on the physical education teacher’s professional skill cultivation and has too few professional skill training contents.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the occupational skill training curriculum setup for physical education teachers.
the occupational skill training curriculum in physical education departments of normal institutes of high education,which is a new research topic in the field of physical education teacher training.
the occupational skill training curriculum of regular physical education teachers, and it has important significance in the occupational skill training of physical education teachers.

the curriculum program for physical education major of normal institutes of higher education is not sufficient for physical education teacher occupational skill training,which is not in line with the new curriculum standards.

the newly issued Physical education Curriculum Standard has set forth new requirements on physical education teacher occupational skill training,but the curriculum programs for the physical education department in the normal institutes of higher education have failed to show sufficient attention to the training, and the occupational skill training curriculum contents for physical education teachers have been too few and the curriculum teaching time too short.

the curriculum program for the education major in physical education departments of normal institutes of higher education has not met the requirements for the cultivation of teachers’ occupational skills in physical education.

we need to further improve the curriculum system for physical education teachers’ occupational skill cultivation in terms of curriculum contents,teaching methods,education practice and evaluation.

we have established an occupational skill training course system for physical education teachers based on the Physical Education Curriculum Standards and Curriculum Programs,which includes 6 courses and 3 training forms.
we have established a curriculum program for the occupational skill training of physical education teachers,which has been implemented in normal institutes of high-learning in Huizhou City.
